label: magic chalk
description: A stub of chalk, warm in your hand, that never seems to wear down. Wherever you draw with it, a line of pale light stays behind in the stone.

label: charm sigil
description: A closed ring of chalk traced around a vacant space on the floor. When an enemy is encircled on every side by such rings, the circle closes and pulls it to your side. The ring flares once and is spent.
look_description: A closed ring of pale chalk glows faintly on the floor, waiting to be completed around something.

label: drain sigil
description: A spiral chalk mark that drinks the energy from whatever stands on it. Each pass of the spiral drinks a little more, then the mark fades. It holds five drainings before it is spent.
look_description: A tight spiral of chalk that seems to drink the light from the floor, leaving the stone cold and grey.

label: worn scroll
description: A dry scroll of old bark, faintly warm. A spiral of charcoal spirals on the bark — a diagram for sapping the strength of whatever stands within. Reading it presses the words for drawing a draining sigil into your head.

label: ember scroll
description: A sheet of fire-cured bark marked with a round amber sigil. Amber strokes circle a tiny ember at the scroll's center — a diagram for a spawning sigil. Reading it reveals the lines that call a creature into being.

label: chisel-axe
description: A wedge of chipped stone half-wrapped in greasy hide, a goblin's skinning tool. It bites into meat and stone alike.

label: bitter moss
description: A wad of crushed herbs and bitter cave moss tied in a scrap of hide. Goblin medicine — it mends wounds the way they mend hides.

label: shaman's ring
description: A ring of dark carved bone and clay, still warm from shaping. It holds the shaman's cunning, an eye for shape and purpose. On your finger it sharpens your mind, and the surviving golems bow to your will.

label: spawn sigil
description: A round sigil drawn in living amber, warm in the hand. It holds the raw names of creatures that can be summoned to this board. What answers the call, and how strong it stands, depends on the strength of the patron who traces it.
look_description: A disc of warm amber chalk, its spiral glowing faintly. It hums against the floor like a buried coal.

label: leaf spear
description: A young spear of leaf-spear wood, straight and honest. A soldier's first blade.

label: leaf helm
description: A helm bound from three leaves of bark. It stands stiff around the head like a crest.

label: leaf crook
description: A crook grown from a bent leaf-branch, tall as a man. It has never once been straightened, and it never will.

label: leaf plate
description: Scores of stiff leaves laid flat and pressed into a breastplate. It does not bend where it should not bend.

label: leaf ring
description: A ring braided from a single long leaf, still green. It rests light as nothing, and sharpens the mind a little.

label: leaf cloak
description: A cloak of wide dark leaves sewn with root-thread. It falls quiet as a deep shelf of soil.

label: leaf gloves
description: Gloves of softened leaf, worn smooth at the palms. They fit the hand like a second skin of bark.

label: leaf boots
description: Boots of packed leaf, quiet on any stone. A thousand strides wear them down, not out.

label: leaf paste
description: A mash of green leaf stamped into a paste. It closes cuts the way a leaf closes over a torn edge.

label: leaf buckler
description: A small round shield of pressed leaves, light in the off hand. It catches blows that are meant for the heart.

label: commander's safe key
description: A heavy brass key with intricate dual wards, looted from Captain Malik. It unlocks the iron safe in the Commander's Bastion.

label: teleport scroll
description: A heavy brass-leaf scroll etched with fine geometric circuits. Reading the dual intersecting triangles teaches the Teleportation Sigil.

label: teleport sigil
description: A double triangle drawn in pale magic chalk. Tracing it before locked gates, portcullises, or barred apertures blinks you instantly to the other side.
look_description: A sharp double triangle of chalk pulses with pale light, vibrating with phase resonance.

label: battered miner's lantern
description: A dented miner's lantern of heavy brass, fitted with low-pressure vent clips. A warm amber filament hums quietly behind the smudged glass. The casing stays faintly warm to the touch, and the initial 'J' is scratched into the base plate beneath layers of old machine grease.

label: iron cage key
description: A heavy brass-and-iron key carried by the cage warden, cut to turn the tumblers of the suspended steam prison cage.

label: fortress gate key
description: A heavy brass skeleton key stamped with the fortress insignia, carried by the gate sentries to lock and unlock the northern bulkhead.

label: brass officer saber
description: A finely balanced curved cavalry saber issued to garrison commanders, with a steam-assisted counterweight in the hilt.

label: bronze incense censer
description: A heavy bronze sphere suspended by fine chains, smelling of sacred resin and cold ash.

label: date flatbread
description: A thick, fragrant sesame flatbread stuffed with sweet dates, baked fresh in Yasmin's steam-heated oven. Restores strength and warmth.

label: steam crossbow bolt
description: A fluted steel bolt designed for high-pressure garrison repeating crossbows.

label: brass gear
description: A heavy, precisely machined toothed cog salvaged from a steam-powered automaton.

label: copper pipe fitting
description: A durable section of high-pressure copper steam pipe with threaded brass couplings.

label: courtyard cage key
description: A heavy frost-bitten iron key stamped with the Citadel crest. It unlocks the mass offering cages in the central courtyard.

label: sensory enhancer
description: A small, translucent blue capsule synthesized in the High Sanctuary of Floor 6. Swallowing it heightens human senses and clears neural static, upgrading the interface map with live ally trackers and active teleport portals.
